tools.name: repairdesk_list_customers
tools.description: Search customer records by keyword or referral source. Returns one page. GET /customers.

tools.name: repairdesk_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer using its ID from customer or ticket lookup. GET /customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_tickets
tools.description: Find ticket/order numbers, customer/device context, status and assignments. keyword searches the ticket list. Returns one page (page defaults0). GET /tickets.

tools.name: repairdesk_get_ticket
tools.description: Read ticket summary, customer, repair devices, notes, line items and invoice context. GET /tickets/{Ticket-Id}. The vendor checks store ownership, including transfers into this store.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_invoices
tools.description: Search invoice numbers and customers; inspect totals, paid status and available balances. One page (page defaults0). GET /invoices.

tools.name: repairdesk_get_invoice
tools.description: Read a single invoice; no payment or invoice creation occurs. GET /invoices/{Invoice-Id}.

tools.name: repairdesk_get_invoice_due
tools.description: Read outstanding invoice amount and paid flag. GET /invoices/{Invoice-Id}/dueamount.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_inventory
tools.description: Look up inventory by ID, name or SKU in keyword. Returns the vendor's items list; this endpoint documents pagesize but no page parameter. GET /inventory.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_devices
tools.description: Read device catalogue by manufacturer/brand or device name. GET /devices.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_parts
tools.description: Read parts names, SKU, stock and pricing. GET /parts.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_statuses
tools.description: Find the store's available ticket status names. GET /statuses.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_networks
tools.description: Read the device network catalogue. GET /networks.

tools.name: repairdesk_get_inventory_options
tools.description: Read available item conditions and physical storage locations. GET /inventory/additionalinfo.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_employees
tools.description: Read only staff ID, display name and role for assignment lookup. Access PINs, permissions, private employee data and payroll are omitted. GET /employees.

tools.name: repairdesk_list_appointments
tools.description: Search leads/appointments with customer/device context and assignment. Returns one page. GET /appointment.

tools.name: repairdesk_add_internal_ticket_note
tools.description: Append an internal note (type0) after explicit confirmation. First reads the ticket and verifies its ID and optional repair/device line ID. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: repairdesk_get_customer, repairdesk_list_tickets, repairdesk_get_ticket, repairdesk_list_statuses · Private data: repairdesk_list_customers, repairdesk_list_inventory, repairdesk_list_employees · Public sink: repairdesk_add_internal_ticket_note · Destructive: repairdesk_add_internal_ticket_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: repairdesk_get_customer, repairdesk_list_tickets, repairdesk_get_ticket, repairdesk_list_statuses · Private data: repairdesk_list_customers, repairdesk_list_inventory, repairdesk_list_employees · Public sink: repairdesk_add_internal_ticket_note · Destructive: repairdesk_add_internal_ticket_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
